scene.line: I'm ready for more flower petals to be blown off, sugar.
I'm no one's sugar!
I could be racing dragonflies right now.
Oh come on Vidia! It's fun helping your friends!
Well, I didn't get a choice and I don't need any friends!
Everyone needs friends.
Not Me! When are you two going to be done?
If you would come help us gather it would go faster.
Fine! Anything to get me away from you two quicker.
There are some more petals just inside those bushes, Vidia.
Help! Help!
Oh no! A snake has Vidia in its coils.
Oh my goodness gracious I have to help Vidia!
Stay back Rosetta, it's small but dangerous.
Great!
It's ok Vidia, just look at me and be calm.
Fawn will help you!
I've never charmed a snake before.
I'll give it a try.
It's working! He's uncoiling, hurry Vidia! Fly away!!
I'm so glad you are ok, Vidia!
Me too! Thanks for helping me.
That's what friends are for.
I'm your friend?
Of course you are!!
Whatever! (Flies off, with a little smile on her face)
